mapper.sql: sch22_write_group_id AS write_group_id, sch22_write_group_nm AS write_group_name, sch22_company_id AS company_id, sch22_confirmer_id AS confirmer_id, emp01_kor_nm AS confirmer_name

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sch22_write_group (sch22_write_group_id, sch22_company_id, sch22_write_group_nm, sch22_confirmer_id) VALUES (#{writeGroupId}, #{companyId}, #{writeGroupName}, #{confirmerId})
mapper.sql: sch02_share_id AS share_id, sch02_info_id AS info_id, sch02_share_cd AS share_code, f_cdnm('ShareCode', sch02_share_cd, sch02_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS share_name, sch02_person_id AS person_id, f_emp_kor_nm(sch02_person_id) AS person_name, sch02_org_id AS org_id, sch02_company_id AS company_id, sch02_start_date AS start_date, sch02_close_date AS close_date
mapper.select: SELECT , CONCAT(f_org_nm(sch02_org_id, f_sysdate()) ,' (조직 폐쇄일 : '||to_char(org01_close_date,'yyyy-MM-dd')||')') AS org_name FROM sch02_share INNER JOIN org01_code ON org01_code_id = sch02_org_id WHERE sch02_info_id = #{infoId} AND sch02_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY sch02_share_cd, sch02_org_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sch02_share ( sch02_share_id, sch02_info_id, sch02_share_cd, sch02_person_id, sch02_org_id, sch02_company_id, sch02_start_date, sch02_close_date ) VALUES ( #{shareId}, #{infoId}, #{req.shareCode}, #{req.personId}, #{req.orgId}, #{companyId}, #{req.startDate}, #{req.closeDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( -- 체크리스트 작성내역 체크 SELECT 1 FROM sch02_share INNER JOIN ics11_checklist_company ON ics11_write_group_id = sch02_info_id INNER JOIN ics15_checklist_write ON ( ics15_checklist_id = ics11_checklist_id AND ics15_company_id = sch02_company_id ) WHERE sch02_share_id = #{shareId} AND ( ( sch02_share_cd = '1' AND sch02_person_id = ics15_person_id ) OR ( sch02_share_cd = '2' AND sch02_org_id = f_get_empTrans(ics15_person_id, f_get_last_day(TO_DATE(ics15_check_yyyymm||'.01','yyyy-MM-dd')), 'org_code_id')::numeric ) ) AND COALESCE(ics15_confirm_yn,'false') = 'true' -- 일일점검내역 작성내역 체크 UNION ALL SELECT 2 FROM sch02_share INNER JOIN chk02_daily_list ON chk02_write_group_id = sch02_info_id INNER JOIN chk03_daily_list_write ON ( chk03_daily_list_id = chk02_daily_list_id AND chk03_company_id = sch02_company_id ) WHERE sch02_share_id = #{shareId} AND ( ( sch02_share_cd = '1' AND sch02_person_id = chk03_person_id ) OR ( sch02_share_cd = '2' AND sch02_org_id = f_get_empTrans(chk03_person_id, chk03_date, 'org_code_id')::numeric ) ) AND COALESCE(chk03_confirm_yn,'false') = 'true' ) t
